description: This file defines a collection of API interaction functions for the frontend layer of a web application. It handles authenticated HTTP requests such as GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE to communicate with a backend API, including comment management and work item CRUD operations. It also manages authorization headers, error handling, and special logic for adding comments and creating work items, including use of localStorage and dynamic imports.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines whether a given API path is public and does not require authorization.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds HTTP headers for API requests, adding Authorization header if the path is protected.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles HTTP error responses, including auto-logout on 401 for protected routes and error propagation.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the backend, returning JSON data or null, with error handling.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON body, returns parsed JSON or throws an error.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request with optional query parameters, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with JSON body, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item given project and item ID.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from localStorage or function argument.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of work items filtered optionally by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, optionally setting creator info from localStorage's auth data.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL based on the API base URL and the provided API path.
